correctness.rationale: Direct expansion reduces the one-step objective ratio to a spectral-moment factor. Reweighting by the first spectral moment turns that factor into a ratio of the first two moments of an interval-valued random variable; the endpoint quadratic inequality and scalar maximization give the sharp Kantorovich value. The two-eigenvalue construction attains equality, so the safety frontiers and minimax scaling follow algebraically. The verifier checks the equality family and random SPD instances as corroboration.
